svg.text: Parent agreement enlists factors with default bearers. A two-axis override grid (scope x audience) decides per-session per-factor bearer at runtime.

g.text: Enlists the subset of cost factors that apply to this CPO. Each enlisted factor
carries a default bearer. The agreement is the only mandatory layer.
{ DSO: USR, ELE: USR, ACS: USR, PRM: USR,
TRF: ORG, SRF: ORG, RNT: ORG, MTR: ORG }

svg.text: overrides flow into the grid below
Layer 2 - Override grid (BearerRule rows live in any cell)
Each row = (cost_factor, scope_node?, audience?, bearer, allocation_rule). Rows are *diffs* against the parent default. Empty grid is legal.

g.text: a tenant's parking row at Dalvegur
factor F at Site for G
factor F at Site for U
factor F at Inst for G
factor F at Inst for U
factor F at Circuit for G
factor F at Circuit for U
factor F at Charger for G
factor F at Charger for U
Enlist subset on each Agreement; default bearer per factor.
DSO Dreifing DSO grid fee (per installation)
SRF Thjonustugjald Service / installer / vendor fee
ORG Kerfiseigandi the CPO ORG (parent agreement counterparty)
WRK Vinnan workplace ORG that owns the DriverGroup
TRD Thridji adili another User pays this driver's bill

svg.text: walk: most specific to least specific

g.text: For each enlisted cost factor F, given Driver U at Charger C (with Circuit, Installation, Site walked from C):
1. BearerRule(F, scope=Charger C, audience=Driver U) -- most specific
7. BearerRule(F, scope=Installation, audience=DriverGroup G) ... continues through Site / All ...
8. Agreement default for F -- least specific (anchor)
First non-null match wins. Result = (bearer_type, bearer_ref, allocation_rule, price_source).

svg.text: Worked example - Dalvegur (workplace site, multiple ORGs, shared chargers)

g.text: CPO ORG = Dalvegur Eignir (parties: Straumvakt <-> Dalvegur Eignir)
Circuits = C1 Sjova bay, C2 Klettas bay, C3 visitors
G_sjova owner = Sjova (workplace) default scope: C1
G_klettas owner = Klettas (workplace) default scope: C2
G_daltekni owner = Daltekni (workplace) default scope: C3
Sjova: absorbs ELE for G_sjova; lets DSO/ACS fall to USR. CEO Anna gets Charger 1 with all factors -> WRK.
Resolution for one session: Anna (G_sjova) at Charger C1-CHA-02
factor DSO -> no driver/group/scope hit -> agreement default -> USR (Anna)
factor ELE -> group rule (G_sjova, scope=null) -> bearer=WRK -> Sjova
factor ACS -> no override -> agreement default -> USR (Anna)
factor PRM -> not idling, not enlisted on this session -> (skip)
factor TRF -> agreement default -> ORG (Dalvegur Eignir)
factor SRF -> agreement default -> ORG (Dalvegur Eignir)
factor RNT -> agreement default -> ORG (Dalvegur Eignir)
factor MTR -> agreement default -> ORG (Dalvegur Eignir)
Anna pays: DSO + ACS Sjova pays: ELE Dalvegur Eignir pays: TRF + SRF + RNT + MTR

svg.text: Notes: WRK bearer resolves via the DriverGroup's owner ORG (stored once on the group). TRD requires a user_id on the rule. The same machinery handles the inverse case where a workplace pushes everything to USR.
